body: Sam LaPorta is the subject of intense contract negotiations with the Detroit Lions, characterized by his expressed readiness to leave the team if a new deal is not reached. Multiple reports indicate he has publicly stated he is prepared to enter free agency and could command a significant payday, while also criticizing the team's lack of engagement in talks.

findings.evidence_quote: Sam LaPorta says he is prepared to leave Detroit if the Lions won't give him a new contract
Lions Predicted to Flip Unhappy Sam LaPorta for Chiefs DB, First-Round Pick
